detailed_descriptions.en: Throw away the Student Handbook. It's the final week of exams and you and your friends didn't study. Dig deep into your arsenal of cheating tools and do whatever it takes to graduate! IT'S FINALS WEEK! Survive a series of increasingly difficult exams while eluding a strict teacher patrolling the classroom. To succeed, you'll have to work together with your friends: you pass together or fail together. STEAL ANSWERS AND SHARE THEM WITH THE SQUAD There are other students who actually studied. Peek at their answers or knock them out if they don't feel like sharing. Find textbooks and pass them around. Use walkie-talkies, cellphones, binoculars, and other tools to find and share answers with your buddies. DON'T. GET. CAUGHT. Cheat around and find out. Various restraints await misbehaving students. Yes, even a Cone of Shame. And watch out for the teacher - he throws erasers with suspiciously deadly accuracy. DRAW ON EVERYTHING! Write down answers and pass them around on sheets of paper. Or just write them on the wall... or your friends' faces. The world is your canvas! HANG OUT IN THE HALL Between exams, the hall is your hangout spot. Play basketball, throw baseballs, decorate statues, and devise your next cheating strategy. TOO COOL FOR SCHOOL Cheating is temporary. Drip is forever. Pass exams to unlock new outfits and accessories for your character. Make sure everyone knows who carried the group.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Throw away the Student Handbook. It's the final week of exams and you and your friends didn't study. Dig deep into your arsenal of cheating tools and do whatever it takes to graduate!

IT'S FINALS WEEK!

Survive a series of increasingly difficult exams while eluding a strict teacher patrolling the classroom.

To succeed, you'll have to work together with your friends: you pass together or fail together.

STEAL ANSWERS AND SHARE THEM WITH THE SQUAD

There are other students who actually studied. Peek at their answers or knock them out if they don't feel like sharing.

Find textbooks and pass them around. Use walkie-talkies, cellphones, binoculars, and other tools to find and share answers with your buddies.

DON'T. GET. CAUGHT.

Cheat around and find out. Various restraints await misbehaving students. Yes, even a Cone of Shame.

And watch out for the teacher - he throws erasers with suspiciously deadly accuracy.

DRAW ON EVERYTHING!

Write down answers and pass them around on sheets of paper. Or just write them on the wall... or your friends' faces.

The world is your canvas!

HANG OUT IN THE HALL

Between exams, the hall is your hangout spot.

Play basketball, throw baseballs, decorate statues, and devise your next cheating strategy.

TOO COOL FOR SCHOOL

Cheating is temporary. Drip is forever.

Pass exams to unlock new outfits and accessories for your character. Make sure everyone knows who carried the group.
